$comment: Runtime config for this landing. This file is served as-is from the public folder and is fetched by the page on every load, so editing it changes the landing WITHOUT a rebuild. Reload the page (or let the dev watcher pick it up) and the landing re-renders.

spins.$comment: Scripted spin outcomes, in order — the CTA popup opens after the last one. type: loss / smallwin / bigwin. 'result' is a per-column array of icon numbers (1-8); its length must match the fixed grid (5 columns x 4 rows desktop, 3x3 mobile) or it falls back to the default layout — the grid itself is not config-driven. 'winLine' is the winning row index per column (null = skip that column).

assets.$comment: Values are either a built-in key (a filename under src/assets/img or src/assets/sound, no extension) or a URL. A URL starting with / , ./ , http:// or https:// is used verbatim, so you can drop custom art into the public folder and point at it here. An empty sound key mutes that sound.

dev.$comment: watch polls this file and re-renders the landing in place when it changes. menu enables the config editor panel — it ships in production builds too, where it saves edits to this browser's localStorage instead of this file.
